0.original:
Hmph...!

Your father's weakling friends have delayed our training...

1.original: Prepare yourself, because from today, we're going to do some actual fighting!

2.original: Alright, follow me! We're headingsoutheast to Nemuria Ruins!

6.original:
...Nemuria Ruins...

That's where that robot saved me when I got lost half a year ago...

Then he got buried in the ruins. I wonder if he's OK...

7.original:
Hey! What are you mumbling about?!

You're training! No time to waste!

11.original: Go and find the Devil's Bracelet that I hid in the deepest parts of the ruins!

13.original:
You still insist on acting like a scared little baby?

It wouldn't be training if I had to hold your hand, right?!

14.original: OK! I'll find the Devil's Bracelet and bring it back!

18.original:
Wow! It's the Nemuria Ruins...

This is where I ran away to from Piccolo's training half a year ago.

This is about where I started crying...

19.original: I hope the robot who saved me is still OK...

20.original:
I better start Piccolo's training!

...He said the Devil's Bracelet was in the deepest parts of the ruins...

21.original:
Hmm... Everywhere I go is a dead end...

Where could it be?

22.original:
Hey! Mr. Robot! You're all right!

It's me! Gohan!

24.original: If only he had his battery, I could talk to him...

25.original: Maybe there's a spare battery somewhere in the ruins!

26.original: I found it! A battery just for him!

27.original:
Now I'll be able to talk to him.

...He might even know where to find the Devil's Bracelet!

29.original: Mr. Robot! Mr. Robot! Wake up! Come on, wake up!

30.original: ...m... mm... Hm? Who has awakened me...?

32.original: Oh, Gohan? What has happened? Have you not run away yet?

33.original:
It's been half a year since I was lost in here!

...I'm glad you were OK!

I thought you were crushed under the ruins after you saved me!

34.original:
...I see. So it has been that long...

...Then why is it that you are here? You should have made it out.

35.original:
...Well... I got caught in some quicksand...

Oh, I have to go deep into the ruins and get the Devil's Bracelet!

Do you know which way to go?

36.original: So, in need of help again, I see... There are cave-ins happening all the time, so I do not know the terrain...

37.original:
I saw a place that looked like I might be able to get through on the way here...

But there was a big boulder in the way...

38.original:
...I see. I would move it for you, but...

As you can see...

39.original: Hmm... How am I gonna move it...?

41.original: This is taking too long! I guess I've got no choice but to see what the problem is...

45.original:
...No problem...

But I better stay on guard.

47.original:
If he dies here, then our chances against the Saiyans will plummet!

I'm probably getting too soft on him, but we'd better join up...

49.original: Yay! You came to save me, right?!

50.original:
...I can't have you dying on me...

Did you find the Devil's Bracelet?

53.original:
Fine. I'll back you up from here.

But in turn you better find that bracelet! Got it?

57.original: Looks like some greedy weaklings have their eye set on treasure...

60.original: I'd like to see just how strong you've become... but I don't like the looks of these guys...

61.original: ...Hey big bro! There's some strange folks over there...

62.original:
...Huh?!

Looks like they're after the ruin's treasure just like us. Thieves probably.

63.original: Hey, then maybe they have some treasure on them already!

64.original:
Yeah!

Let's give them a little scare and relieve them of their goods while we're at it!

66.original:
Hey you!

So, you after the treasure too?!

67.original:
We're kinda famous in these parts...

We won't tell anyone, so...

If you wanna avoid a beating, hand over your treasure and make for the exit!

68.original:
You think you're bad guys, eh? Don't make me laugh!

I'll show you real evil!

69.original:
Hah! Just keep on talkin' like that!

Go get 'em, excavation robot!

72.original:
Mr. Piccolo, you said to them you'd show them real evil...

But they're the evil ones. I think what you showed them was the power of good...

74.original: Quit talking nonsense... We found the Devil's Bracelet, so we're getting out of here!

76.original: Hmm... Looks like you've at least gotten over your cry baby syndrome...

78.original: Hey Piccolo... You and my dad fought in the past, right?

79.original: That fight still isn't over... After we defeat the Saiyans your father is next on my list...

80.original:
But...

Dad told me that you're not as bad as the Piccolo from the past...

81.original: I think he's right... Mom and grandpa were scared of you though...

82.original:
Enough of your babbling! Go to sleep!

Tomorrow's training won't be as nice as today's was!

85.original:
Chiaotzu?

I don't think he would have left Kami's Lookout...You can't find him?

86.original:
Yeah...

I've been looking for him since morning and I still can't find him...Do you know anything, Mr. Popo?

87.original: I haven't seen him since last night...I'm worried...

89.original: I don't feel his Ki anywhere nearby... Try talking to Kami...

90.original: Looks like Chiaotzu's no where to be found...

91.original: You should try looking for him below.

93.original: Yes. Go and see Baba. She may know something.

94.original:
I understand.

We'll go below and look for him! Training will only be put on hold until we find him.

95.original:
Do not worry!

Going below will be a part of your training. I wouldn't want to train fighters who don't value their comrades.

97.original: What? What?! What are you all doing here?

99.original:
We don't know where Chiaotzu has gone!

We thought maybe you might help us find a clue...

100.original:
Hmm...

I guess you boys aren't playing around.

101.original: Could you use your power to help us find him?

102.original: Easily done! Hoy hoy hoy sa sa!

105.original: It seems he's at Master Mutaito's training grounds!

107.original: Right! The place where it is said Master Mutaito himself trained.

108.original: What would Chiaotzu be doing in a place like that?!

109.original: My powers tell me that he didn't go there by his own will.

111.original: That's right. Simply put, he was kidnapped! ...I think?

113.original: I don't know. You should go to the training grounds.

115.original: So this is where Master Mutaito trained. I think I'm getting goose bumps!

117.original: Hah hah hah hah! I've been waiting for you, Tien!

118.original: Don't tell me you've forgotten my voice already.

120.original:
Heh heh! The traitor has finally shown himself!

Now where did that other traitor go... Oh, there he is!

122.original:
To get even with you!

You had become too strong at the last World Tournament, like you said!

You tore my pride to pieces...

123.original:
Pride? Pride?! All you cared about was winning! Your fists ignored all decency.

You had no pride to begin with!

124.original:
That's what I'm talking about!

I must shut that high and mighty mouth of yours!

I brought you here to make you pay for the sorrow you caused my brother

after you caused him injury beyond recovery!

125.original:
Are you saying that for that, not only would you hurt Chiaotzu...

But you would insult Master Mutaito himself?

126.original:
Hah hah hah!

I'll make you pay for your conceit in front of my master, Mutaito.

Prepare yourself, Tien. I've analyzed my brother's battles and put the data into this super robot.

I'll let TPP-EX take you to the other side!

132.original: We have only one master... And that's Master Roshi!

133.original: Tien... What a sad thing to happen...

135.original:
I see...

So he was upset over his brother then...

But Tien... You should have nothing more to worry about now.

136.original: ...That's right! No matter how many times you showed him the wrong in his ways he wouldn't learn!

137.original: Yes... I know it, but... I still can't help it...

138.original:
You warned him!

He'll never show his face around you again!

142.original: I never thought once enemies such as yourselves would have ever formed such a strong bond.

143.original:
You have all surpassed me long ago.

Mr. Popo and I have nothing more to teach you.

I believe it would be best if you returned to the world below to polish your various techniques before the showdown.

144.original: I leave the future in your hands.

145.original: ...Can I take off this heavy clothing now then?

147.original:
Everyone was doing good!

I was worried about Piccolo and Gohan, but they seem to be doing fine!

148.original: I see, I see... Well then, let's continue the training, shall we?

149.original: OK! ...So, what are you going to teach me next?

151.original:
Spirit Bomb?

...Sounds powerful! What kind of technique is it?!

152.original:
If you can complete the task I have for you, I'll teach it to you...

...First, go to Yemma's Forest and bring me the Spirit Crystal!

154.original:
Right! A forest sprite should have it!

...But there's a little problem... You remember how Raditz went on a rampage?

He downed a Yemma Tree and blocked the road to the tree the sprites live in!

156.original:
You know Gregory, right?

That tree is where he used to live!

The elder Montgomery should have the Spirit Crystal...

157.original: ...But the road's been blocked. How am I supposed to get there?

158.original:
Hah hah hah! That's why I have this nutrient!

It's a secret recipe.

Bubbles and I make it as a hobby.

This stuff will help raise any plant...

159.original:
Oh, man! It reeks!

Are you sure this'll make that Yemma Tree go back to normal?

160.original:
Heh heh! I can guarantee it'll work!

...All right? Raditz broke five trees in all!

If you heal all five trees, the road to the tree the sprites live in should open...

Go see Montgomery and bring the Spirit Crystal back to me!

163.original: You can use the Kaioken if you want to now!

164.original:
Yes.

You did well mastering something not even I myself could not...

You impress me, Goku...

However I urge you not to overuse it.

If you lose control, your own body could be destroyed...

165.original:
Don't go over two times the power.

Got it?

Taking the Kaioken beyond that would be too much for your body...

Your body won't be able to keep up and the technique will backfire...

168.original: ...So, this is where the sprites live! It's huge!!

170.original: So, you're after the Spirit Crystal as well...

171.original: Raditz?! You're still here? You just won't give up, will you?

172.original:
You should know better than that!

If I can get a hold of the Spirit Crystal I'll gain power greater than that of King Yemma himself!

173.original: What do you plan to do after that?

174.original: What do you think?! I will rule all of Hell!

176.original:
Whew...! How stubborn can you get...

I wonder if he was telling the truth about the Spirit Crystal being able to make someone more powerful than King Yemma...

177.original:
Oh well!

I need to hurry up so I can learn the Spirit Bomb from King Kai...!

181.original:
Oh! Gregory, is that you??

Have you been keeping up the hard work under King Kai??

183.original: What's wrong? I suppose you're not just home to visit...

184.original: That's right! I brought a man from Earth with me!

187.original: ...And what is it this man from Earth wants?

188.original: King Kai told me to find the Spirit Crystal!

189.original:
If that's all you're looking for then take all you need...

Here!

190.original:
That was pretty easy...

Isn't this something really important?

192.original: Yeah. Raditz said that it would grant power greater than King Yemma...

193.original:
Wah hah hah! Sounds like Goz and Mez have been up to their old lies again!

It's just something of a protective charm to us sprites!

You can find them rolling all over this area!

194.original: I wonder why King Kai had me come and get one then...

195.original:
Hmm...

Maybe he wanted for us to meet...

196.original:
I don't really understand it all, but thanks!

I gotta get back to King Kai's place! Later!

197.original:
...Elder. Are you sure about giving that Earthling the Spirit Crystal?

It's supposed to only be given to those as proof of learning the Spirit Bomb...

198.original: Just what have you been learning under King Kai??

199.original:
You saw the pureness in his eyes, didn't you?

He'll put the Spirit Bomb to good use, I'm sure of it!

Are you sure you don't want to go after him? Aren't you supposed to still be training?

203.original:
Look! I brought the Spirit Crystal you told me to get!

Why did you make me go after it? The elder said it was just a plain old protective charm!

204.original:
Yes, well...

Think about it. I'm sure you've gained some strength in getting it, haven't you?

205.original: Come on, King Kai! Hurry up and teach me the Spirit Bomb!

206.original:
Heh heh.

Looks like Montgomery has seen just how capable he is.

208.original: I can't wait much longer! There's not much time!

209.original: The truth is... You've already attained the Spirit Bomb!

211.original:
That was like a sort of graduation test.

Gregory even said you saved him!

212.original: I can't believe it. All that work for nothing!

213.original: It wasn't for nothing! What do you think you're sayin', Saiyan? Hee hee!

214.original:
*Cough cough*

Each time you complete the training I assign to you,

you gain the means to greater control your Ki!

216.original: By choosing Ultimate Attack during battle, you will be able to use the Spirit Bomb!

217.original: All right! So I've gained an Ultimate Attack!

219.original:
But listen, Goku. This is a technique that borrows a small amount of energy from things like the grass, trees, humans and animals.

Eventually the energy from things and the air itself can be gathered and released.

You can even tap into the massive energy of the sun.

It will be a Spirit Bomb of enormous power.

If you make one mistake, you could destroy the very planet that you are trying to protect.

Only use it if you have to!

220.original:
OK! Gotcha, King Kai.

I'll be fine. The Kaioken should be enough!

221.original:
Well, the day of the decisive battle has come!

The Saiyans will descend to Earth tomorrow.

222.original: Oh no! Tomorrow! I've really done it this time!!

224.original: I... I forgot to add in the time it would take you to travel back across Snake Way!

225.original:
Couldn't you just beam me down to Earth with one of your tricks?

You mean I have to go back the way I came?!

It took me half a year to get here!

226.original:
I'm sure you could make it there in only a couple days now!

I'll contact Kami and tell him to meet you to take you to Earth!

227.original: But that'll be one day too long! Everyone might get killed!

228.original:
You don't have to remind me! I'm allowed to make mistakes too, aren't I?!

Now! Hurry up and tell your friends on Earth to wish you back to life!

230.original: Put your hand on my back and you can tell them telepathically!

233.original: (...M-Master Roshi... Master Roshi, it's me, Goku. Can you hear me?)

234.original: Goku! Is that you? Where are you??

235.original:
(Great! You heard me! I'm still on the other side.

I'm talking to you telepathically.)

237.original: (Did you gather all the Dragon Balls?)

238.original:
Yes, we already did!

We did it all together... To bring you back...

239.original:
(Thanks.

Sorry to be in such a rush, but could you summon Shenron and wish me back to life now?

The Saiyans will arrive on Earth tomorrow!)

240.original:
What?! They'll be here already?!

That's a month earlier than I expected!

241.original:
(Hurry, Master Roshi! I'm gonna be a little late.

I promise I'll do what I can!)

242.original:
All right, Goku! By the way...

I heard you've been training there. How has it come along?

245.original: Is...he OK in there? I can hear him mumbling...

246.original: I wonder if he's just lost it...

247.original: Hey, everyone! Get the Dragon Balls together right away!

248.original: That was cool, King Kai! I actually got through!

249.original:
Heh heh... Of course you did.

Now, while we wait for them to revive you, I'll do something about those tattered clothes...

251.original: Wow! I feel a whole lot lighter!

252.original:
They aren't just light. That's strong material.

Light attacks will bounce right off.

253.original:
Thanks, King Kai! Oh, good! The symbol of the turtle is still there!

I was worried I was gonna end up with the stupid looking symbol on your clothes!

256.original: The symbol on the back is the number one fashion point!

257.original: Make your wish! I will grant any wish, but only one!

258.original:
Hey! Umm...

Could you maybe beat up the Saiyans and save the Earth? Would that wish be OK...?

259.original: What are you saying! You want to just forget about Goku being dead?!

260.original:
No!

We could just bring him back the next time... Why not?

261.original:
I can not grant that wish.

Kami is my creator. I can not grant wishes that exceed Kami's power.

262.original: Then I wish for you to bring Goku back to life!

264.original: It's the middle of the day and it's dark out!

265.original: (Looks like Goku is about to be revived...)

266.original: That means that the Saiyans are coming sooner than I thought!

267.original:
Good!

The halo's gone! You're back to life! Now, hurry!

269.original:
Now remember, your enemy is evil and stronger than you can imagine!

You can't let your guard down even for a moment! Don't think you can be brought back to life again!

270.original:
I'll be all right! I can only be brought back to life once with the Dragon Balls!

I'll give it all I've got!

271.original: Thanks for everything, King Kai. If I die again, I'll be sure to visit!

272.original:
There seems to be no limit to his strength...

And his heart is as clear as crystal...

Who would have thought someone like him existed in the lower world.

Although he didn't have much of a sense of humor...

I'll have to instruct him on that the next time...

273.original: This is great! I feel so light! Like my whole body's made out of cotton!

274.original: This is no time to be fooling around though! I better hurry!

275.original: And so, at 11:43AM the next day, the Earth was invaded by two Saiyans!

278.original: Looks like something... fell from the sky...

279.original: I knew it...! That round thing fell from the sky!
